mapper.sql: id, sign_key_id, institution_id, purpose, action, status, target_key_version, expected_version_before, observed_version_after, prepared_at, last_call_at, owner, lease_until, before_value::text AS before_value, after_value::text AS after_value, reason, requested_by, approval_id, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_kms_operations ( id, sign_key_id, institution_id, purpose, action, status, target_key_version, expected_version_before, observed_version_after, prepared_at, last_call_at, owner, lease_until, before_value, after_value, reason, requested_by, approval_id, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{signKeyId}, #{institutionId}, #{purpose}, #{action}, #{status}, #{targetKeyVersion}, #{expectedVersionBefore}, #{observedVersionAfter}, #{preparedAt}, #{lastCallAt}, #{owner}, #{leaseUntil}, CAST(#{beforeValue} AS JSONB), CAST(#{afterValue} AS JSONB), #{reason}, #{requestedBy}, #{approvalId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_kms_operations WHERE sign_key_id = #{signKeyId} AND status IN ('PREPARED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'RECORDED')
SELECT FROM tb_kms_operations WHERE status IN ('PREPARED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'RECORDED') ORDER BY prepared_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_kms_operations SET status = #{status}, observed_version_after = #{observedVersionAfter}, before_value = CAST(#{beforeValue} AS JSONB), after_value = CAST(#{afterValue} AS JSONB), reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
